text: - Nutrient timing around the exercise bout should be considered in the context of the peri-workout period. It seems prudent to consume high-quality protein (at a dose of approximately 0.4 to 0.5 g/kg of lean body mass) both pre- and post-exercise within about 4 to 6 hours of each other, depending on meal size. Those who train partially or fully fasted should consume protein as quickly as possible post-workout.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
